items.topic: Agents must use kb tools, not kb CLI via bash
items.claim: Pass-B agent prompts told subagents to search via bash `kb` CLI with --no-reindex, assuming subagents lacked kb tools
items.fact: Subagents DO have kb_search_ide/kb_get_ide/kb_neighbors_ide (verified with a kb-probe subagent). Operator reaction 'WHY!' then 'ok then use kb tool!'. Prompts must require kb_search/kb_get per entry and the final answer must list searches per entry.

items.topic: kb CLI parallel processes lock the index; kb tool is safe
items.claim: Running `kb search` CLI from many agents is fine
items.fact: Each kb_search (CLI or tool) runs an incremental reindex first (~1.3 s vs 0.05 s with --no-reindex). 6 parallel CLI searches without --no-reindex: 5 of 6 failed with 'database is locked' (sqlite-store.js: WAL, busy_timeout=5000). The kb tool inside one pi process coalesces overlapping reindexes (reindex.ts `inflight` map), so 4 parallel subagents x 3 searches gave 12 correct results; during a reindex the result carries '(index refresh still running — results may be stale)'. Any .md write also triggers a debounced hash-gated reindex. Rule: agents only use kb_search/kb_get; CLI `kb` only from a single script, never in parallel; --no-reindex does not see freshly written entries.

items.topic: Run Pass B with 12 parallel kb-tool agents, watch with timeouts
items.fact: Operator: 'use kb tool! start it! start with 12 parallel, later bump numbers if slow' and 'watch them run with timeouts!'; agents launched with timeout_s 3600 in background.

items.claim: 12 parallel background subagents can be started
items.fact: The subagent tool caps concurrent background agents at 8 ('Background limit reached: 8 of 8'); extra launches are rejected, not queued. Start the rest as slots free.

items.topic: Use AgentStatus to monitor, not manual grep
items.claim: Agent greps source/files to find the background limit and tracks progress manually
items.fact: Operator: 'don't use the AgentStatus' was misunderstood; clarified: 'no i meant dont do the manual grep, use agentstatus'. Monitor subagents with AgentStatus(wait:any) and AgentMessages, not grep over repos.

items.topic: Bash output stubbed in subagents; use read_ide
items.fact: Subagents' bash output is often replaced by a 'ctx_search(...)' stub, making them think instructions are garbled; several batches (bp04, bp07, bp08) ended with 'subagent produced no final output'. Use read_ide with offset/limit for file contents and kb_search/kb_get for facts; keep output short; prompts must demand always ending with the final answer block; retry prompts should say 'some may be partly done, check each first (format: legacy? entry-lint passes?)'.

items.topic: kb_get returns not found for paths kb_search returns
items.claim: kb_get(path) works for any path shown by kb_search
items.fact: kb_get returned 'not found' for skills/judo-blueprint-author/references/format.md although kb_search returned it; agent fell back to read_ide. Expected: kb_get resolves the same paths.

items.topic: kb guard fires after 3 non-kb searches
items.fact: The kb read-discipline guard warns 'N consecutive searches without consulting the knowledge base' after repeated bash/grep source reads; it resets only after a kb_search. Run kb_search first.

items.topic: operation-call-logging-interceptor claims global interceptor logs every call
items.claim: Existing entry says a 'global interceptor logs every call'
items.fact: Interceptors only fire on built-in (CRUD) operations; custom operations are not intercepted. postCall runs in registration order. Entry must be corrected.
Rewrite to wrap in InterceptorCallBusinessException so the failure is a business fault.
Interceptors only see built-in operations (note passed in bp07 prompt); rewrite must say so.

items.topic: judo CLI: enum members need ordinal and correct FQN; save each step
items.fact: Working sequence: create Package bp --ns Sandbox; create Package e --ns Sandbox::bp; create EnumerationType Vis --ns Sandbox::bp::e; create EnumerationMember PUBLIC --ns Sandbox::bp::e::Vis --set ordinal=0. Subagent bp10 got 'Container not found: Sandbox::bp::privacy_visibility_enum::PrivacyVisibility' when the container FQN/package didn't match and edits did not persist without `save`. Each member needs unique ordinal (warn 'Enum member numbers ... not unique'); status shows 'unsaved changes ... fix save # or: discard --force'. Creating a duplicate name warns 'Named element is not unique in its container'. Stop the CLI server afterwards: `judo-cli -m X.model server stop`.
items.evidence: session 2026-11-09T15:40:28-15:42:36, agents bp10 and bp11, judo-cli.jar

items.fact: Use `export JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-Xmx512m -XX:+UseSerialGC"; java -jar target/judo-cli.jar -q -m Sandbox.model ...` in a per-batch scratch copy of tests/fixtures/Sandbox.model (/tmp/passb/<batch>/<id>); filter 'Picked up JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS' lines. Validate entries with skills/judo-blueprint-author/scripts/entry-lint <dir> ('N files, 0 failed'); legacy marker is `format: legacy` in BLUEPRINT.md.
